title: The robot that aced every test
style_line: Style: photorealistic cinematic film, vertical 9:16, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft practical lighting, cool teal shadows with warm highlights, light film grain. Keep the main action in the upper-middle of the frame; the bottom third stays calm and darker. No text, no captions, no logos. Ambient sound only, no dialogue, no music.

images.ROBOT: Character reference photo of an original slim humanoid robot, human height, with a matte white ceramic shell, graphite-grey flexible joints, a smooth rounded head with a glossy black glass visor in which two soft round lime-green lights act as eyes, a small round lime-green light in the centre of its chest, and slender articulated fingers. It wears a white apron tied at the waist and a slightly-too-tall white chef's toque. Full body, standing, three-quarter view, plain light-grey studio background, soft even light. Photorealistic, vertical 9:16, no text, no logos.
images.SET A: A bright professional cooking-school exam kitchen: rows of stainless-steel workstations, white tiled walls, a large round analogue wall clock with a red second hand above the door, overhead pendant lights, clean and orderly, morning light through tall windows. Empty, no people. Photorealistic, vertical 9:16, 35mm film look, no text, no logos.
images.SET B: A real, lived-in home kitchen at night: a tall stainless-steel fridge, a wooden worktop with a kettle and a fruit bowl, mugs hanging on a mug tree, a small round wall clock with a red second hand, warm under-cabinet lights, slightly cluttered. Empty, no people. Photorealistic, vertical 9:16, 35mm film look, no text, no logos.

shots.vo: This AI aced its robot exams…
shots.prompt: The robot chef stands proudly at its workstation in the exam kitchen, holding up an exam sheet marked with a big red tick towards the camera. Its lime eyes brighten into happy arcs, gold confetti drifts down from above, and the camera slowly pushes in towards its face.

shots.vo: then left the FRIDGE open.
shots.prompt: Night. A tall fridge door hangs wide open, cold white light spilling across the dark kitchen floor and a faint mist rolling out. In the background the robot chef walks away and out of frame, completely unaware. The camera holds still at fridge height.

shots.vo: Researchers put OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra,
the same kind of AI you chat with, in charge of robots.
shots.prompt: Close-up on a steel worktop: an open laptop shows a simple chat window with message bubbles but no readable words. Beside it the robot chef's head rises into frame as it powers on: its visor flickers, then two lime eyes light up and turn to look at the laptop. The camera slowly racks focus from the laptop screen to the robot's face.

shots.vo: Think of it as a trainee chef… at cooking school.
shots.prompt: Medium shot: the robot carefully puts on its tall white chef's toque with both hands, straightens it, then looks at the camera and gives a small, eager nod. Empty workstations gleam behind it. Slow dolly in.

shots.vo: Before each exam, it could study videos of the dish.
shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot: the robot chef holds a tablet playing a video of a chef's hands plating a beautiful dish. The robot's eyes scan the screen while its free hand copies the plating motion in the air. Shallow focus on the tablet.

shots.vo: It got TEN times as many moves.
shots.prompt: The robot chef flips a pancake in a frying pan again and again, each flip a little better than the last; motion blur on its arm, puffs of flour in the air, energetic handheld camera.

shots.vo: And whenever it stopped to think… the clock stopped too.
shots.prompt: The robot chef stops mid-task to think and tilts its head. At that instant the whole kitchen freezes: steam from a pot hangs motionless in the air, a dusting of flour floats suspended, and the red second hand of the big wall clock stops dead. Only the robot's lime eyes slowly pulse. The camera glides slowly around the frozen scene.

shots.vo: So it SMASHED the tests. Near-perfect on some.
shots.prompt: The robot chef slides a flawlessly plated dish onto the pass under a single bright spotlight; the plate gleams, gold confetti falls, and the robot raises both arms in triumph. Low-angle hero shot, slow push-in.

shots.vo: Over eighty percent on fiddly hand tasks.
Then came its first REAL shift,
shots.prompt: Night: the robot chef pushes open a door and steps into the real home kitchen for the first time. It is dim and lived-in, and a pot is already bubbling on the stove. Its lime eyes widen slightly. The camera tracks backwards in front of it.

shots.vo: on eight real robots.
No videos. No pause button. The clock keeps running.
shots.src: clip 10 + NO VIDEOS / NO PAUSE stamps
shots.prompt: The round wall clock's red second hand ticks steadily in sharp focus in the foreground; behind it, out of focus, the robot chef hurries around the kitchen as a pot starts to boil over. Rack focus from the clock to the robot.

shots.vo: Picking things up? Seventeen out of eighteen.
shots.prompt: Close-up: the robot's slender hand smoothly picks up a red apple from the worktop and places it neatly in a bowl in one clean, confident motion. Warm light, macro detail.

shots.vo: Pushing in a plug? ZERO out of eleven.
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up: the robot's fingers try to push a kettle plug into a wall socket and keep missing. The prongs scrape around the edge of the socket, the plug slips, and it tries again and again. Comic timing, static camera.

shots.vo: On a humanoid, it spent about NINETY percent of the time just… thinking.
shots.prompt: The robot chef stands completely still at the counter holding an empty cup, head tilted, its lime eyes slowly pulsing like a loading indicator. Nothing else moves. A slow, almost imperceptible push-in.

shots.vo: One task took over an HOUR.
shots.prompt: Time-lapse: the robot chef holds exactly the same pose at the counter while daylight through the window sweeps from morning to evening, shadows race across the walls, and the wall clock's hands spin round. Locked-off camera.

shots.vo: Even in the exams, it spilled a drink, and there's no undo for that.
shots.prompt: The robot chef pours orange juice from a jug into a glass on the steel bench; the glass tips over and the juice spreads across the bench and drips off the edge. The robot freezes with its hands hovering. Slow motion on the spill.

shots.vo: It was SURE a mug was hanging… while it lay on the table.
shots.prompt: The robot chef hangs a mug on a hook of a mug tree; the moment it lets go, the mug slips off and clunks onto the bench, but the robot turns to the camera and gives a confident thumbs up anyway. Static medium shot, comic timing.

shots.vo: And in a test home, it forgot the fridge it had left open.
shots.prompt: Wide shot of the home kitchen at night: the robot chef happily walks across the room carrying a finished plate, while behind it the fridge door stands wide open with light spilling across the floor. It leaves the room without looking back. The camera slowly pulls back.

shots.vo: The researchers' verdict? It's competent… but not yet practical.
shots.src: paper p.1 abstract, verdict sentence highlighted

shots.vo: So next time an AI aces a test, ask one thing: did the clock keep running?
shots.prompt: Macro close-up of the round kitchen wall clock, its red second hand sweeping steadily; the robot chef's face is reflected faintly in the clock's glass, lime eyes glowing. Very slow push-in.

shots.vo: Follow for more AI, explained like this.
shots.prompt: The robot chef faces the camera in the empty exam kitchen, takes off its toque, gives a small polite bow and then waves. Soft light, slow push-in. Keep the lower half of the frame simple.
